text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - feature/cross-collateral-implementation
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - feature/cross-collateral-implementation

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build project (Preview Only)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/feature/cross-collateral-implementation'
        run: pnpm build
```
